D/ CONSTANTINVS PF AVG ; R/ CLA[RITAS REI PVBLICAE]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), London mint Claritas Rei Publicae issue of 317, RIC volume 7 no. 124, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Sol standing left with right arm extended downwards. Reverse inscription: CLA[RITAS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: PLN.
